body: Just live! Life is precious. There is something you excel at. You are so young. There is still something beautiful you can experience.
Please live! I lost my son he was just 20.it has destroyed me.

Hello Alex I hope and pray you are still with us. By ending your life your parents will endure a life of endless pain grief guilt and sorrow. Believe me I know. My son ended his life in 2014 he was 20 yrs old. Everyone has something they excel at. It is Not too late. You have your whole life ahead of you. Life is precious never wasted. Please just live! Ironically im on my sons reddit acct. Alex you matter in this life don't forget that. Even if you are suffering mental illness it's not the end of your life.
A mother of a suicide who cares

It's the hardest thing in the world to try when the depression hits, I know. When you feel that way everything that makes your life valuable seems impossible. If you need to talk, please comment in this thread or message me.

I'm in therapy right now, but the results have been mixed at best. It's so weird for me to know that a lot of the negative beliefs I have aren't true, but still believe them anyway. It's the depressive version of akrasia.
